messages:
ria: hey, new engineer stuck on sample-cli during onboarding. installed the wheel but `redwoodctl` binary not present :confused:
ria: they ran `pip install dist/sample_cli-0.2.0-py3-none-any.whl` and import `sample_cli` works, but trying to run `redwoodctl` gives `command not found`.
ben: do we add the console script in pyproject under `[tool.poetry.scripts]`?
ria: yes - `redwoodctl = \"sample_cli.cli:main\"` is in pyproject, and `poetry build` shows it in logs. wheel metadata looks odd though when inspected.
tony: any chance the package name uses a hyphen while the module uses underscore? wheels sometimes have mismatches but entry points should still come through.
ash: I saw a similar failure where an old `setup.cfg` existed and `pep517` isolation used different metadata. if `setup.cfg` or legacy `setup.py` present, some backends treat entry_points differently. can you check repo for leftover packaging files?
ria: checked - yep, there's a stray `setup.cfg` from before we switched to poetry. removing it and rebuilding produced the console script locally.
ben: also worth noting: if contributors use `python -m build` vs `poetry build` there can be subtle differences depending on build-backend. docs should recommend `poetry build` to avoid surprises.
tony: pipx can make this worse: `pipx install dist/...whl` will install the distribution name, not module name, and sometimes the binary isn't created if entry_points missing. recommend `pipx install --spec ./dist/...whl` or use PyPI package name.
nash: unrelated but hit by the new hire: async sample app raised `ImportError: cannot import name 'Protocol' from typing_extensions` on py3.11. looks like `typing-extensions` got pinned to 4.5 in the lockfile from another dev dependency.
ben: support for some Protocol features landed in typing-extensions 4.6+. solution: declare `typing-extensions >=4.6` in dev deps for the sample repo, and loosen any strict pins in the template. also run `pip check` in CI to detect such issues early.
tony: action list: 1) scrub legacy `setup.cfg` from sample templates, 2) update quickstart to prefer `poetry build` and include a short verification snippet to inspect `EGG-INFO/entry_points.txt`, 3) add CI job that creates a clean venv, installs the wheel, and asserts the CLI binary exists (`which redwoodctl`), 4) add `typing-extensions >=4.6` to sampleapp dev dependencies and update lockfile.
ria: I'll open a PR for the template cleanup and doc update.
ci-bot: created task RED-DEVEX-421: \"sample-cli wheel missing console script when legacy setup.cfg present\" assigned to @ria
ben: I can add the CI gate as a small GH action; will add a job that runs on `push` for sample templates.
nash: add a troubleshooting note to onboarding: how to inspect wheel entry points quickly: `unzip -p dist/*.whl "*.data/entry_points.txt" || unzip -p dist/*.whl "{package}/EGG-INFO/entry_points.txt"`
tony: also record a short note about pipx quirks and hyphen/underscore differences so new hires don't get confused.
ria: thanks all — will follow up with PR links. this saved a screenshare. :tada:
